services.name: Fishing Info
services.desc: If you are looking for guided fishing charters in addition to your boat and equipment rentals, please check out Kenai Sportfishing. Kenai Sportfishing offers a wide variety of Kenai River and Kasilof River Guided Fishing trips. They also offer bear tours and fly-in fishing trips originating in Soldotna, Alaska and they operate 4 daily halibut trips departing from Homer, Alaska. We do most of our Kenai River king salmon fishing on the lower Kenai River and middle Kenai River. There are a few reasons for this. First, the water speed, and underwater topography make for really great action on our lures and plugs. Second, It’s estimated that almost 70% of the entire late king salmon run spawn

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Alaska Boat Rental has the largest and newest fleet of rental boats in the region. We specialize in open sport boats that are ideal for fishing or exploring the Kenai Peninsula. Whether it is our drift boats, the 18 foot Pro V, or the 20 foot Super Pro V, we have the boat for you. All boats are on trailers, so they go where you want to go! If you are looking to rent a powerboat for the Kenai River it’s important that you’ve had previous experience operating a boat on the Kenai River. If you have never done so we strongly encourage you to book a guided fishing trip with us that we will also use as a river and safety orientation course. All rental equipment is available the evening before
